recipe.visualDefinition: A surrealist composition featuring an instant film photograph floating at a diagonal angle against a dramatic, lightning-filled blue sky. The photograph contains a group portrait of four people, with ghostly, translucent hands reaching out from the frame into the surrounding sky.
coreVisualRelationships: The diagonal tilt of the photo frame creates a sense of dynamic suspension.
The lightning bolts in the background frame and highlight the central floating object.
The translucent hands bridge the gap between the internal photo world and the external sky environment.
High contrast between the dark interior of the photo and the bright electrical discharge of the sky.
coreInvariants: A central square-format instant film frame with a thick white bottom border.
Electric blue sky with white and pale yellow lightning strikes.
Translucent, reaching hands overlapping the frame edges.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A large instant photo frame is centered but rotated approximately 30 degrees clockwise, dominating the middle third of the canvas.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The group portrait inside the dark photo frame serves as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the lightning bolts from the top down toward the central photo, then follows the reaching hands outward.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The stormy sky provides textured negative space that adds to the atmospheric tension.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blue and indigo sky tones establish the mood.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white and pale yellow for the lightning and the photo frame border.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm skin tones and dark blacks within the photo portrait.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the black photo interior and the bright electrical flashes.
paletteRestrictions: Keep sky tones within the blue-to-purple spectrum

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used in multiple colors/corners for symmetry.
graphicDevices: Horizontal underline beneath the top-left text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric 1970s aesthetic and uniform stroke weight.
Provides the necessary geometric clarity and sharp corners.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a surreal image of a stormy blue sky with bright white lightning. In the center, place a tilted, square instant film photo frame. Inside the frame, show a dark group portrait of four people. Add translucent, ghostly hands reaching out from the photo into the sky.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place geometric sans-serif text in all-caps in the corners of the image. Use white for the top-left (with an underline) and top-right, and pale yellow or red for the bottom corners.

verificationChecks: Are the hands translucent and reaching out of the frame?
Is the lightning bright against a dark blue sky?
Is the text placed in the extreme corners?

mustRedesign: Specific faces of the individuals in the portrait
Any specific brand logos on the photo frame

mustAchieve: Clear distinction between the 'photo' world and 'sky' world

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the lightning does not obscure the faces in the photo.
Check that the photo frame looks like physical instant film (thick bottom margin).
Verify the text is legible against the stormy background.
Confirm the hands appear to emerge from the photo's internal space.
recipe.reuseFormula: Surreal collage + [Subject in Instant Photo] + [Atmospheric Background] + [Translucent Reaching Elements] + [Corner-Aligned Geometric Typography]
